understanding: Comment un capteur transforme une perturbation en signal électrique.

candidates.action: A yellow disturbance hits the sensor, a blue light within the sensor lights up and creates a trail.
candidates.explains: Shows the conversion from disturbance to electrical signal.
candidates.misses: Doesn't show how the signal is sent away from the sensor.

candidates.action: A blue electric signal exits the sensor and travels through visible wires.
candidates.explains: Shows the signal being sent away from the sensor.
candidates.misses: Fails to show the initial disturbance and conversion inside the sensor.

candidates.action: The motion sensor casing becomes translucent, showing both the yellow disruption hitting the sensor and a blue signal emitting from it.
candidates.explains: Illustrates both the disruption causing the signal and the start of an electrical output.
candidates.misses: Doesn't show how the signal propagates further than the sensor.

why_chosen: This action shows both the cause (disruption) and the initial conversion (electrical signal starting) within one frame, quickly understandable.
